note: Triennial election of the rural district council, due on Thursday 2 June 1955. The returning officer's notice of result (dated 3 June 1955) lists fifteen divisions: twelve candidates elected unopposed and three retiring councillors (Glenavy, Magheramesk, Montiaghs) deemed re-elected; no poll was held (BNL 18 May 1955 p8 also reports no election for Lisburn Rural Council). Returning officer's notice, column 5 (elected); no poll: "There will be no election for Lisburn Rural Council" (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8). Returned unopposed.
